system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 9. 3 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (48 seconds, code score 0.83) ---
[b00] ACTION: Alexander steps forward and unlatches the cottage door, opening it into the pouring rain.
[b01] PEASANT MOTHER (frantic, weeping): "Please! They told me there was a woman here who knows herbs. My boy is burning with fever!"
[b02] JULIANA (urgent, compassionate): "Bring him here. Quickly."
[b03] ACTION: The trembling mother gently lays the feverish boy down atop the wooden table as Juliana leans in close.
[b04] JULIANA (reassuring, focused): "He seems very unwell, but he is resting steadily. How long has he been like this?"
[b05] PEASANT MOTHER (trembling, anxious): "Since yesterday morning. He has barely eaten since sunset."
[b06] ACTION: Juliana lifts the weathered herbal book and rapidly browses the handwritten pages.
[b07] JULIANA (muttering, intent): "Feverfew... Not alone."
[b08] JULIANA (determined): "Chamomile... and willow bark."
[b09] ALEXANDER (grave): "You're certain?"
[b10] JULIANA (resolute): "I have to be."
[b11] ACTION: Juliana quickly grabs bundles of dried herbs from the table and turns to Alexander.
[b12] JULIANA (urgent): "Alexander, I need hot water."
[b13] ALEXANDER (prompt): "I'm on it."
[b14] ACTION: Alexander hurries to the hearth and lifts a boiling iron kettle from the hearth chain, while the mother buries her face in her hands.
[b15] PEASANT MOTHER (sobbing): "Please save him."
[b16] ACTION: Alexander returns and pours steaming hot water into the stone mortar as Juliana prepares the remedy.
[b17] JULIANA (gentle, steadfast): "He is not beyond saving."
[b18] ACTION: The child swallows weakly and lets out a soft cough.
[b19] PEASANT MOTHER (despairing): "Why isn't it working?"

--- WINDOW 1 (44 seconds, code score 0.75) ---
[b00] ACTION: Juliana quickly grabs bundles of dried herbs from the table and turns to Alexander.
[b01] JULIANA (urgent): "Alexander, I need hot water."
[b02] ALEXANDER (prompt): "I'm on it."
[b03] ACTION: Alexander hurries to the hearth and lifts a boiling iron kettle from the hearth chain, while the mother buries her face in her hands.
[b04] PEASANT MOTHER (sobbing): "Please save him."
[b05] ACTION: Alexander returns and pours steaming hot water into the stone mortar as Juliana prepares the remedy.
[b06] JULIANA (gentle, steadfast): "He is not beyond saving."
[b07] ACTION: The child swallows weakly and lets out a soft cough.
[b08] PEASANT MOTHER (despairing): "Why isn't it working?"
[b09] JULIANA (quiet, focused): "Wait."
[b10] PEASANT MOTHER (overcome with emotion): "His fever... it's breaking."
[b11] PEASANT MOTHER (tearful, grateful): "You saved him."
[b12] JULIANA (soft, gracious): "The herbs did their work. Let him rest."
[b13] ACTION: Juliana places a comforting hand over the mother's hands.
[b14] ACTION: The mother gathers her sleeping son in her arms and steps back toward the rainy doorway.
[b15] PEASANT MOTHER (reverent, vowing): "I will tell the village what you did. They will never forget you."
[b16] ACTION: The mother exits into the rainy twilight as Alexander pushes the door shut.
[b17] ALEXANDER (stern, warning): "You cannot let the whole village start talking about you."
[b18] JULIANA (defiant, principled): "A child's life matters more than gossip."
[b19] ALEXANDER (dark, cautionary): "Gossip has a way of becoming dangerous."

--- WINDOW 2 (31 seconds, code score 0.73) ---
[b00] ACTION: The mother exits into the rainy twilight as Alexander pushes the door shut.
[b01] ALEXANDER (stern, warning): "You cannot let the whole village start talking about you."
[b02] JULIANA (defiant, principled): "A child's life matters more than gossip."
[b03] ALEXANDER (dark, cautionary): "Gossip has a way of becoming dangerous."
[b04] JULIANA (committed, unshakable): "Then we will face it together."
[b05] ACTION: The Former Groom, soaked from the rain and clutching his hat, walks nervously through the double doors into the study.
[b06] BLOND NOBLEMAN (aloof, without looking up): "What is it?"
[b07] GERALD (hesitant, deferential): "There is a rumor going around, my Lord."
[b08] BLOND NOBLEMAN (coldly curious): "What rumor?"
[b09] GERALD (uneasy): "About a war veteran. Some say he resembles the late Duke."
[b10] BLOND NOBLEMAN (mocking, arrogant): "People see ghosts whenever they want a story."
[b11] GERALD (tense, solemn): "The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried after the war."
[b12] BLOND NOBLEMAN (sharp, demanding): "Where?"
[b13] GERALD (cautious): "No one seems certain."
[b14] BLOND NOBLEMAN (dismissive, masking panic): "Then let it remain a rumor."

Pick the single best promo.
